description: Replacing a chained OLE value through a recordset with objects present: Lv row 5 changes from 9000 to 12000 bytes. Asks about the other values' bytes and the catalog. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it. The full catalog view is taken before the steps and after them (each a read-only open, with its own file state).

args.text: SELECT Id, ParentId, Name, Type, Flags, DateCreate, DateUpdate FROM MSysObjects ORDER BY Id
